name: GD-Peeker — HTML, Markdown, XML & Text Viewer for Google Drive™
description: Render .html, .md, .txt and .xml files from Google Drive™ in a new tab. No server, no sign-in, nothing leaves your browser.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https: data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https: data:; img-src * data: blob:; font-src * data:; media-src * data: blob:; connect-src *; child-src 'self' data: blob:; frame-src 'self' data: blob:
